svg.title: The current branch, branch picker and unchanged starting commit
svg.desc: 1: The status bar names the current branch. 2: The branch picker can create a branch or switch to an existing one. 3: Both branch names initially point to the same short commit ID. 4: Graph marks the checked-out branch.
